discovery.title: Finding and joining
discovery.description: Two separate settings: whether people can find this circle, and how they get in.
discovery.readOnlyDescription: How this circle is currently found and joined.
discovery.discoverabilityHelp: This decides whether the circle appears in search and under Discover.
discovery.discoverableDescription: Anyone can come across this circle.
discovery.hiddenDescription: Only people with the link will see it.
discovery.accessHelp: Separate from being findable — a hidden circle can still accept requests.
discovery.requestDescription: People ask to join, and the circle decides together.
discovery.inviteDescription: Only people who are invited can join.
discovery.saveFailed: We couldn't change that setting. Please try again.
discovery.leadNote: You can change these two settings because you are a lead. Any member can also ask for a change by opening a motion, and the circle decides together.
discovery.proposeInstead: Only a lead can change these directly. You can ask the circle to change them by opening a motion.

archive.title: Archive this circle
archive.description: Put the circle away without losing any of it.
archive.alreadyArchivedBody: Everything is still here — members, decisions, projects and history. Bringing a circle back is not something you can do from this screen yet; ask support if you need it.
archive.bulletKept: Nothing is deleted. Members, decisions, projects and history all stay exactly as they are.
archive.bulletQuiet: The circle stops being an active place: it drops out of discovery and no longer takes new members.
archive.bulletReversible: Archiving is not final. A circle can be brought back — though not yet from this screen.
archive.dialogDescription: This closes the circle down. It does not delete it, and nothing inside it is lost.
archive.failed: We couldn't archive this circle. Please try again.
archive.leadOnlyBody: Only a lead can archive this circle.
archive.dissolvedBody: This circle has been dissolved, which is final. It can no longer be archived or reopened.
archive.proposeInstead: You can ask the circle to wind down by opening a motion, and the members decide together.

history.title: Decision history
history.intro: Every decision this circle has made, newest first. Each entry is sealed to the one before it, so the record can be checked rather than taken on trust.
history.beginning: That's the whole record, back to the day this circle started.

error.load: We couldn't load the decision history. Please try again.

empty.title: Nothing decided yet
empty.description: When this circle opens its first motion, every step of the decision will be recorded here.

verified.title: Record verified
verified.body: Every entry still matches the one before it. Nothing has been changed or removed since it was written.

broken.title: This record no longer matches its seal
broken.body: An entry has been changed or removed. Nothing below can be treated as proof of what this circle decided. Please report this.

unchecked.title: Not verified
unchecked.body: We couldn't check the record just now, so we're not claiming it's intact. Try again in a moment — usually the service was briefly unreachable.

actor.erased: By a member who has since deleted their account
actor.notPublished: Recorded — individual votes are never published

events.inviteLinkRedeemed: Someone joined with an invite link

governance.title: How this circle decides
governance.intro: The rules this circle has set for itself: what needs a vote, and what it leaves to a lead or to any member.

error.load: We couldn't load the governance rules. Please try again.

empty.title: No rules set yet
empty.description: This circle hasn't published its governance rules. Once it does, you'll see exactly what each kind of decision takes.

pinned.title: These are today's rules
pinned.body: A motion keeps the rules it opened under for as long as it runs. Changing a rule here never changes a vote already in progress — that is what stops an amendment rewriting a decision midway.

howItWorks.title: How a vote works here
howItWorks.quorum: Quorum is about turnout, not agreement: an abstention counts as taking part.
howItWorks.majority: The result is worked out from Yes and No votes only. Abstentions are set aside.
howItWorks.tie: An exact tie never passes on its own.
howItWorks.silence: If the window closes without quorum, nothing happens. Silence is never consent.

majority.unanimous: Everyone who votes must say Yes
majority.note: Counted from Yes and No votes only.

quorum.twoThirds: Two thirds of the circle must vote
quorum.threeQuarters: Three quarters of the circle must vote

window.note: Counted from the moment the motion opens.

history.title: How this rule changed
history.viewMotion: See the motion that changed it

plan.title: Plan & usage
plan.loadError: We couldn't load your plan. Please try again.
plan.partialLoad: Some of this screen didn't load. What's shown is up to date — try again for the rest.

membersOnly.title: Members only
membersOnly.description: A circle's plan and what it's using are visible to its members. Your circle is on a plan either way — every circle always is.

price.yearlyNote: The yearly price is its own price, not twelve monthly ones.

current.heading: Your circle is on
current.payerNote: Paying for the circle grants no extra say. Whoever pays has the same single vote as everyone else and can decide nothing alone.
current.alwaysOnAPlan: Every circle is always on a plan. The free one is a plan, not the absence of one.
current.moveToFree: Move back to the free plan

allowance.heading: What your plan covers
allowance.intro: And what you're using now, so you can see why something would be turned down before you try it.
allowance.windowNote: This only changes how far back the chat is shown. Nothing is deleted, and a longer window brings the older messages straight back.
allowance.brandingOffNote: Your custom colours are saved and come straight back on a plan that includes them. Your circle just shows the standard look meanwhile.

locked.MAX_MEMBERS: You have {current} members. Your plan covers {limit}. Nobody is removed — you just can't add anyone new until you're under {limit} or back on the larger plan.
locked.MAX_ACTIVE_PROJECTS: You have {current} projects running. Your plan covers {limit}. Nothing is closed or deleted — you just can't start another until one finishes or your plan changes.
locked.MAX_ACTIVE_CHALLENGES: You have {current} challenges running. Your plan covers {limit}. Nothing is cancelled — you just can't start another until one closes or your plan changes.
locked.STORAGE_MB: You're using {current} of {limit}. Nothing is deleted — you just can't upload anything new until some space is freed or your plan changes.

billing.heading: We set paid plans up by hand for now
billing.body: We can't take payment for a circle inside the app yet. Free plans switch straight away; for anything else, tell us what your circle needs and we'll set it up. Nothing about your circle changes while you wait.

catalogue.heading: Every plan
catalogue.intro: Plans are built to order, so each one is its own set of limits rather than a step up or down from the others.
catalogue.notPurchasable: This plan isn't self-serve yet — we set it up for you.
catalogue.leadOnly: Only a lead can change the circle's plan.
catalogue.unavailable: The list of plans isn't available right now.

change.title: Switch to {plan}?
change.noDirection: This isn't an upgrade or a downgrade — just a different set of limits.
change.increases: Anything this plan raises takes effect straight away.
change.decreases: Anything it lowers simply locks. Your circle keeps every member, project and challenge it already has, and can only add new ones once it's back under the new limit.
change.willLockHeading: These would be full right away:
change.willLockReassurance: Nothing on this list is removed. Only new additions wait.
change.error: We couldn't switch the plan. Your circle is unchanged — please try again.

cancel.title: Move back to the free plan?
cancel.body: Your circle stays exactly as it is — same members, same projects, same challenges, same chat. It just moves onto the free plan.
cancel.locksNotEvicts: If anything ends up over a free-plan limit, that limit simply locks: nothing is removed, and you can add new ones again once you are under it.
cancel.successNow: Your circle is on the free plan.
cancel.successLater: Your circle moves to the free plan at the end of this period.
cancel.error: We couldn't change the plan. Your circle is unchanged — please try again.

MISSING_TOKEN.description: The invite code is missing from the address. Links often get cut short when they are pasted into a chat. Ask for it again and open it in full.

MALFORMED_TOKEN.title: This link looks cut short
MALFORMED_TOKEN.description: The invite code is not complete. That usually happens when a link breaks across two lines in a message. Ask for it again and open the whole address.

INVALID.title: This invite link is not valid
INVALID.description: We could not match it to any circle. It may have been mistyped or cut short on its way to you.

EXPIRED.title: This invite link has expired
EXPIRED.description: Invite links only last a few days. This one has passed its date, so it cannot be used any more.

REVOKED.title: This invite link was withdrawn
REVOKED.description: A lead of the circle took this link down. Anyone who already joined through it stays a member, but the link itself no longer works.

EXHAUSTED.title: This invite link is used up
EXHAUSTED.description: Every invite link can be used a limited number of times, and this one has reached its limit.

CIRCLE_FULL.title: This circle is full
CIRCLE_FULL.description: There was nothing wrong with your link. The circle has simply reached the number of members its plan allows. A new link will not help: someone in the circle would need to make room or move to a larger plan.

CIRCLE_UNAVAILABLE.title: This circle is not taking new members
CIRCLE_UNAVAILABLE.description: There was nothing wrong with your link, but the circle is not open at the moment. There is nothing to do from here: check back later or ask someone in it.

UNKNOWN.title: We could not use this link
UNKNOWN.description: Something went wrong on the way to the circle. Trying again often works.
